correctness.rationale: Planar Minkowski mixed-area formula for regular n and m polygons reduces the cross term to n sampled support values. The gcd g and L=lcm(n,m) yield g copies of an N=n/g-term cosine progression with angular step 2π/L; its odd/even finite trigonometric sum gives Bnm cos distance to θmax+2πZ/L. Strict cosine monotonicity gives all L maxima/minima, cusp minima and angular CDF; uniform nearest-lattice distance gives the mean perimeter-product formula. All n,m>=3 and positive radii covered, including gcd and parity cases. Independent convex-hull computation matched 300 mixed-order orientations to <8×10^-15.
